## 3. Search development (pilot, v1) and recall validation

Pilot strings (v1) were run first and validated against the Stage A records already judged relevant (a known-relevant reference set). Missed records were inspected and the concept blocks extended (safe multi-agent RL; racing, parking, platooning, connected vehicles, driving policy, kinematic bicycle model, lane change, ACC, car-following, merging, unsignalized intersection; safety constraint/guarantee) and a title-only query (Q3) was added to compensate for missing abstracts in OpenAlex.
